ExternalCancellationReason1Code.purpose: camt.056 撤销请求里的原因码（请求方为什么要撤）

codes.name: InvalidCreditorAccountNumber
codes.definition: Wrong account number in Credit Transfer.

codes.name: IncorrectAgent
codes.definition: Agent in the payment workflow is incorrect.

codes.name: WrongAmount
codes.definition: Amount is not the amount agreed or expected.

codes.name: InvalidDebtorIdentificationCode
codes.definition: Debtor or Ultimate Debtor identification code missing or invalid.

codes.name: CoverCancelledOrReturned
codes.definition: Cover payments has either been returned or cancelled.

codes.name: IncorrectCurrency
codes.definition: Currency of the payment is incorrect.

codes.name: RequestedByCustomer
codes.definition: Cancellation requested by the Debtor.

codes.name: CancelUponUnableToApply
codes.definition: Cancellation requested because an investigation request has been received and no remediation is possible.

codes.name: TimeOut
codes.definition: Cancellation requested because the original payment order expired due to time-out.

codes.name: InvalidDate
codes.definition: Invalid date (for example, wrong or missing settlement date).

codes.name: DuplicatePayment
codes.definition: Payment is a duplicate of another payment.

codes.name: FraudulentOrigin
codes.definition: Cancellation requested following a transaction that was originated fraudulently. The use of the FraudulentOrigin code should be governed by jurisdictions.

codes.name: ForwardToNextAgent
codes.definition: To complement a rejection response, suggesting the request for cancelation should be forwarded to the next agent in the payment transaction chain.

codes.name: FinalResponse
codes.definition: Direct Debit Tracking recalled as Mandate Cancelled

codes.name: IndemnityRequired
codes.definition: To express the wish to establish a bilateral indemnity agreement.

codes.name: ModifiedTransaction
codes.definition: The underlying transaction in relation to an RTP was modified.

codes.name: TransactionAlreadyPaid
codes.definition: The underlying transaction in relation to an RTP was already paid (via other means).

codes.name: ServiceNotRendered
codes.definition: The payment is cancelled since a cash amount rendered was not correct or goods or a service was not rendered to the customer, e.g. in an e-commerce situation.

codes.name: RequestToSettlementSystemAdministrator
codes.definition: Cancellation requested by System Member to Settlement System Administrator to indicate that the cancellation request must not be forwarded further in the chain.

codes.name: TechnicalProblem
codes.definition: Cancellation requested following technical problems resulting in an erroneous transaction.

codes.name: UnduePayment
codes.definition: Payment is not justified.

codes.name: EndUserError
codes.definition: Cancellation or request for return requested by the Debtor specifically due to one or more errors by debtor in the original Credit Transfer. Usage: This code can be used for any error in the original Credit Transfer made by the Debtor. Can also be used if multiple errors were made in the original Credit Transfer.

codes.name: UnauthorizedPayment
codes.definition:
The Debtor is requesting a return of the payment because the payment was not properly authorized._x000D_
Usage: This code can be used in the case where a Credit Transfer was made without proper authorization from the Debtor. This could be due to compromised end user credentials.

codes.name: Narrative
codes.definition: Reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.

codes.name: InvalidDebtorAccountNumber
codes.definition: Debtor account number invalid or missing.

codes.name: BatchInstructionAlreadySettled
codes.definition: Process a cancellation request but batch already settled.

codes.name: InvalidCancellationRequest
codes.definition: Process a cancellation request with incorrect reference to original batch.

codes.name: DuplicationRequestToPay
codes.definition: Duplication of a request-to-pay message.

ExternalPaymentCancellationRejection1Cod.purpose: camt.029 否定决议里的拒绝原因码

codes.name: ClosedAccountNumber
codes.definition: Account number specified has been closed on the receiver’s books.

codes.name: AwaitingDebitAuthorityFromCustomer
codes.definition: Reported when the cancellation request cannot be processed because customer has not yet provided the debit authority on its account.

codes.name: AgentDecision
codes.definition: Reported when the cancellation cannot be accepted because of an agent refuses to cancel.

codes.name: InsufficientFunds
codes.definition: Amount of funds available to cover specified message amount is insufficient.

codes.name: AlreadyReturned
codes.definition: Cancellation not accepted as the transaction has already been returned.

codes.name: AwaitinReply
codes.definition: Reported when the cancellation request cannot be processed because no reply has been  received yet from the receiver of the request message.

codes.name: CustomerDecision
codes.definition: Reported when the cancellation cannot be accepted because of a customer decision (Creditor).

codes.name: LegalDecision
codes.definition: Reported when the cancellation cannot be accepted because of regulatory rules.

codes.name: Narrative
codes.definition: Reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.

codes.name: NoAnswerFromCustomer
codes.definition: No response from beneficiary (to the cancellation request).

codes.name: NoOriginalTransactionReceived
codes.definition: Original transaction (subject to cancellation) never received.

codes.name: PassedToTheNextAgent
codes.definition: Reported when the cancellation request cannot be accepted because the payment instruction has been passed to the next agent.

codes.name: RequestingDebitAuthority
codes.definition: Reported when authority is required by the Creditor to return the payment.

codes.name: WrongSequence
codes.definition: Reported when the cancellation request cannot be processed because the sequence referred to in the request is not valid.

codes.name: CancellationIndemnityRequired
codes.definition: Complementing a Pending or Reject Status. Payment cancellation request cannot be accepted until an indemnity agreement is established.

codes.name: AlreadyCancelledRTP
codes.definition: Request-to-pay has already been cancelled.

codes.name: AlreadyExpiredRTP
codes.definition: Request-to-pay Expiry Date and Time has already passed.

codes.name: AlreadyRefusedRTP
codes.definition: Request-to-pay has already been refused by the Debtor.

codes.name: AlreadyRejectedRTP
codes.definition: Request-to-pay has already been rejected.

codes.name: PaymentAlreadyTransmittedExecution
codes.definition: Payment related to the request-to-pay has already been transmitted for execution.

codes.name: RegulatoryReason
codes.definition: Regulatory Reason.

codes.name: RfCAlreadyRejected
codes.definition: Request for cancellation of the request-to-pay has already been rejected.

codes.name: RfCNeverReceived
codes.definition: Request for cancellation of the request-to-pay has never been received.

codes.name: RfCReceivedAndProcessed
codes.definition: Request for cancellation of the request-to-pay has already been received and processed.

codes.name: UnknownRTP
codes.definition: Request-to-pay is unknown.

ExternalInvestigationExecutionConfirmati.purpose: camt.029 的决议结论码（含肯定/否定/未决）

codes.name: AcceptedDebitAuthorisation
codes.definition: Used when a creditor accepts the debit authorisation.

codes.name: AcceptedClaimNonReceipt
codes.definition: The claim for non-receipt of a payment instruction is accepted.

codes.name: AcceptedValueDateAdjustment
codes.definition: The claim for value date correction is accepted.

codes.name: ChargesDetailsProvided
codes.definition: Further charges details are provided to resolve the case.

codes.name: CancelledAsPerRequest
codes.definition: Used when a requested cancellation is successful.

codes.name: ConfirmationOfPayment
codes.definition: Used when a payment has been checked and was correctly executed without any intervention.

codes.name: CorrectValueDateAlreadyApplied
codes.definition: The original value date was correct.

codes.name: CancellationWillFollow
codes.definition: Used when a payment will be cancelled to solve an investigation case.

codes.name: CancellationRequestForwardedToTheNextAgent
codes.definition:
The cancellation request has been forwarded to the next agent for execution.
Usage: This code should only be utilised where a Case Id is not present.

codes.name: CoverInitiated
codes.definition: Used when a transfer of funds has been initiated (a cover payment) to resolve a case.

codes.name: InstructionIsDuplicate
codes.definition: Used when the requested check for a possible duplicate instruction is confirmed.

codes.name: PaymentInitiated
codes.definition: Used when the result of an investigation is, or will be, the initiation of a payment instruction.

codes.name: PaymentInstructionInitiated
codes.definition: Used when a payment instruction (eg. MT103) has been initiated to resolve a case.

codes.name: CoverModified
codes.definition: Used when a transfer of funds has been modified (a cover payment) to resolve a case.

codes.name: ModifiedAsPerRequest
codes.definition: Used when a requested modification is successful.

codes.name: ModificationWillFollow
codes.definition: Used when the payment will be modified to solve an investigation case.

codes.name: PendingCancellationRequest
codes.definition: Used when a requested cancellation is pending.

codes.name: PartiallyExecutedCancellationRequest
codes.definition: Used when a requested cancellation has been partially executed.

codes.name: PurposeDetailsProvided
codes.definition: Further purpose details are provided to resolve the case.

codes.name: RejectedCancellationRequest
codes.definition: Used when a requested cancellation has been rejected.

codes.name: RejectedClaimNonReceipt
codes.definition: The claim for non-receipt of a payment instruction is rejected.

codes.name: RejectedValueDateAdjustment
codes.definition: The claim for value date correction is rejected.

codes.name: StatementEntryCorrect
codes.definition: Used when the entry in the statement is correct.

codes.name: StatementEntryIncorrect
codes.definition: Used when the entry in the statement is incorrect and further information is provided with the resolution.

codes.name: UnableToApplyWillFollow
codes.definition: Used when sender wants to respond to an assignment with an Unable To Apply workflow.

codes.name: BatchInstructionAlreadySettled
codes.definition: Process a cancellation request but batch already settled.

codes.name: InstructionDoesNotExist
codes.definition: Process a  Batch Cancellation "using an incorrect batch sequence number”.

codes.name: InvalidCancellationRequest
codes.definition: Process a cancellation request with incorrect reference to original batch.

codes.name: AdditionalInformationSent
codes.definition: Used when additional information has been sent to the beneficiary of a payment.

codes.name: NoInformationAvailable
codes.definition: Used when no additional information is available.

codes.name: Pending
codes.definition: Used to inform that a response to an investigation is pending.
